sample_points_on_bones: sample points along bone line segments with uniform or random interpolation
apply_linear_blend_skinning: apply Linear Blend Skinning to deform 3D points using bone transforms and weights
compute_closest_distance_to_points: compute Cartesian distance from 3D points to bone line segments
compute_closest_distance_to_rays: compute distance between bone segments and camera rays with closest point parameters
project_points_to_bone_space: project 3D points into bone-local coordinate space relative to bone heads
